title: Extending ntrs with T-scores
text: package provides functions standardizing neuropsychological test results using T-scores adjusted age, sex, education. extension ntrs package. main function, std_using_tscores(), takes raw scores various neuropsychological tests applies appropriate T-score adjustments based demographic factors. package includes specific implementations different tests, ANIMALS test, ensures standardized scores within valid range. Disclaimer None implementations used commercial products standalone medical advice. package distributed MIT Licence, meaning software provided “asis” authors liable claim, damages liabaility arising software. Also, note authors behind T-scores implemented request scores edited, modified, translated otherwise part derivative work without prior written permission Mayo Clinic. use T-scores, contact Nikki Stricker /see Mayo Clinic Study Aging website data sharing.
